As a Malayali movie enthusiast, it appears that Shetty universe in sandalwood is making amazing quality movies that are genuine and fun at same time. They have found a unique recipe for quality commercial movies. Raj B shetty produced this movie. There is hardly any famed actors , other than Raj b shetty himself acting a role.

This is some what of dark comedy , with a feel good ending. Every single one of the actors excels. Only one I found not so great is the role that director played himself. Must watch.

Su from So" is the kind of film that sneaks up on you - starting simple, then blooming into something deeply emotional. The story revolves around Su, a small-town soul caught between love, guilt, and self-realization. The movie doesn't rush; it breathes. The cinematography is subtle yet stunning, painting ordinary scenes with a remarkable sense of life. The direction feels grounded, letting the performances speak louder than the dialogues. The lead actor delivers a restrained performance that lingers long after the credits. What stands out most is the authenticity - nothing feels artificially cinematic. The pacing is a bit slow in the midsection, but the emotional payoff in the last act hits hard. This isn't your regular commercial movie; it's a mood, an experience that grows on you over time. "Su from So" proves that silence can sometimes say more than sound ever could.

This one will leave you thinking no other movie could be funnier. The laughter doesn't stop, neither does the entertainment.

There's something about the entire cast in this film. It makes you wonder how such talented actors remain under the radar. Most of them were part of GGVV, yet here, they feel like entirely different performers. That's how good they are.

The coastal wave is real.

Man of the Year for KFI? JP Thuminad. The director. He makes every single person on screen feel essential. And that says everything about his craft. Subtle, but absolutely impeccable.

After three years of theatre visits filled with disappointment, KFI finally hits us with a banger.

Before going in movie I had heard that it was good but didn't knew much about it or even what genre it is but man what a film this was. It takes time to start but the way they developed the story with the lead entering the room and possession and all it was good. My favourite parts were the one where the villagers were getting scared and start running away those were truly a gem reactions. I just don't know why is there no hindi dub because some people are missing this. If you can watch with subtitle then it is a good fun watch.

I haven't laughed this hard in years! What an absolute gem Su from So is! From the very first scene to the last, the movie had me and my family in splits - and yet, it tugged at our heartstrings at just the right moments. I took my parents along, and I can honestly say we haven't had this much fun at the movies together in a very long time.

Every punchline was sharp, every scene was loaded with nuance, and every actor truly shone. The attention to detail in every single frame whether it was the hilarious bojja's scene, the beautifully captured wedding moments, or the small cultural nods only a true Mangalorean would catch - was simply brilliant. There's so much local flavor, but also so much universal emotion.

A huge kudos to the entire team!

The cast delivered powerhouse performances - each one brought their A-game, and it was a joy to watch their chemistry on screen.

You've given us a film that's both entertaining and rooted in our culture.

And Thank you for backing a project that brings so much laughter and joy, while staying authentic to its roots.

This is not just a movie, it's an experience - one that you want to share with your whole family. Clean, clever, culturally rich, and absolutely hilarious. Su from So is more than a film - it's a celebration!
